scholarships.title: 2026/2027 Chinese Government Scholarship - China-Indonesia Scholarship in Higher Education Program
scholarships.official_source: Embassy of the People's Republic of China in the Republic of Indonesia

existing.description: The Embassy of the People's Republic of China in the Republic of Indonesia opened the 2026/2027 Chinese Government Scholarship, which includes the China-Indonesia Scholarship in Higher Education Program with 20 places for undergraduate, master's and doctoral study in China. The award is described as a full scholarship but explicitly does not include international travel expenses. Applicants apply online through the China Scholarship Council system at www.campuschina.org using Indonesian agency number 3602, and no paper materials are sent to the Embassy.
eligibility: Be a citizen of a country other than the People's Republic of China
Be in good health both mentally and physically
Be a high school graduate under the age of 25 when applying for undergraduate programs
Be a bachelor's degree holder under the age of 35 when applying for master's programs
Be a master's degree holder under the age of 40 when applying for doctoral programs
Be a high school graduate (at least) under the age of 45 when applying for general scholar programs
Be a master's degree holder or an associate professor (or above) under the age of 50 when applying for senior scholar programs
Take the China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA) and upload a valid score report when applying for bachelor programs
Have Chinese proficiency of HSK Level 3 for Chinese-taught general scholar programs (students of Chinese language are exempted)
Have Chinese proficiency of HSK Level 3 for Chinese-taught senior scholar programs
Have Chinese proficiency of HSK Level 4 for Chinese-taught master's or doctoral programs
Applicants who obtained their degree from a Chinese university using Chinese as the teaching language do not need to provide relevant language proficiency certificates
Meet the admission requirements of the applied universities in terms of academic ability, language proficiency and other relevant criteria
existing.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be citizens of a country other than the People's Republic of China, be in good health, and satisfy the age ceiling for their level: under 25 for undergraduate, under 35 for master's, under 40 for doctoral, under 45 for general scholar and under 50 for senior scholar.
benefits: Full scholarship covering study in China under the China-Indonesia Scholarship in Higher Education Program
20 places for undergraduate, master's and doctoral programs
Recruitment specifically for students going to China to study marine, medical, health, tourism, education and other required majors
coverage: Full scholarship as described by the Embassy, excluding international travel expenses
requirements: Obtain Pre-Admission Documents from the chosen Chinese universities before submitting the online application

Bachelor's applicants must register for and sit the CSCA before the application deadline; applicants intending to enrol in September 2026 were required to register and take the CSCA on December 21, 2025 or January 25, 2026
Uploaded supporting documents must be clear, authentic and valid; applicants bear the consequences of unclear or unidentifiable uploads
documents: Application Form for Chinese Government Scholarship (in Chinese or English)
Passport home page: clear scanned copy of the information page of an ordinary passport, valid for at least 12 months from the expected start date of study
Notarized highest diploma; prospective diploma winners must submit official proof of student status from their current school
Academic transcripts, with notarized Chinese or English translations if not in Chinese or English

Language qualification certificates: HSK score report for Chinese-taught master's, doctoral, general scholar and senior scholar programs, or IELTS/TOEFL-type certificates for programmes taught in other languages
CSCA Score Report for applicants seeking a bachelor's degree
Pre-Admission Documents issued by the universities applied to, such as a pre-admission notice or an invitation letter from a school or professor; at least one is required
Study Plan or Research Proposal in Chinese or English (minimum 200 words for undergraduates, 500 for non-degree students, 800 for postgraduates)
Two letters of recommendation in Chinese or English from professors or associate professors, for graduate or senior scholar programs
Example of Art/Other Supporting Documents for art or design related majors
Valid documents of the applicant's legal guardians in China if the applicant is under 18
Photocopy of the completed Foreigner Physical Examination Form if staying in China for more than 6 months
Non-criminal record report issued by the local public security authority, usually issued within 6 months prior to submission
existing.english_requirement: Applicants for programs taught in other languages are required to provide relevant language proficiency certificates, such as IELTS or TOEFL score reports, in accordance with the requirements of each university
application_method: Online application and document upload in the China Scholarship Council system at www.campuschina.org, using Indonesian agency number 3602
No paper materials need to be sent to the embassy
existing.duration: Undergraduate: 2-4 years; Master's: 1-3 years; Doctoral: 2-4 years
existing.application_period: 2026/2027 cycle ran from the 2025-10-27 announcement to 2026-02-08; the Embassy then forwarded recommended applications to the China Scholarship Council between 2026-02-09 and 2026-03-05, and results were available in the system in July-August 2026.
existing.deadline_display: Applications for the 2026/2027 cycle had to be submitted online "before February 8, 2026"; that date has passed and the Embassy has published no date for the following cycle.
